They were added in the early 1970s based upon the Federal Clean Air Act citizen supervision and they were designed to address serious air quality and noise quality, problems that continue to this day. NRDC was among the first groups to use the air code provision in the 1980s when we went after diesel bus idling and diesel bus visible emissions.
